name.zh-CN: 网络拓扑可视化编辑（本地预览）

description.zh-CN: 仅本地 Demo：拖入创建、自由布局、连线调整关联、新建草稿垃圾桶删除、受保护网络校验与 90 秒模拟确认回滚。
description.en-US: Local demo: create and move objects, reconnect networks, trash new drafts, protect system networks and confirm or roll back within 90 seconds.

compatibility.tower: Local standalone demo only; live CloudTower compatibility has not been validated.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 本地预览。标准包仅包含不执行网络操作的占位入口；完整交互在独立 demo 包。禁止用于真实网络变更。
releaseNotes.en-US: Local preview. The standard package has a dormant entry; the standalone demo archive contains the interactive editor. No live network changes.
